notes.title: We Are Here Now!
notes.content:
Dear Dungeon Crawlers,

We are here now! Minimal Dungeon RPG is totally available on Steam today.
We give a 10% discount on the first release. There is no in-game purchase.

Enjoy!

Don't forget to share with your friends if you like the game a lot ^ ^

Do not hesitate to let us know if you have any questions or need any assistance.

notes.title: We are Coming on March, 7th
notes.content:
Hi Dungeon Crawlers,

Good News! We plan to release the game before March, 15th. The game Minimal Dungeon RPG will be officially released on March, 7th. Stay tuned and enjoy!

notes.title: Let’s Play Minimal Dungeon RPG! (Developer Livestream)
notes.content:
Hi Dungeon Crawlers,

We are excited to announce that Minimal Dungeon RPG will be in the Steam Next Fest February 2022!
We will show the gameplay of our demo via a Livestream. Schedule your time!

What’s more?
We would like to present our demo a little earlier than the Steam Next Fest. The demo will be live from Feb 10, 2022 until the end of the Festival on Feb 28, 2022. 5 Stages of the full game are included in the game. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Minimal Dungeon RPG Can Be Added to Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
